assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: pixel-aligned binary material segmentation mask for an existing 1536x1024 artwork. Convert the input into a black-and-white mask, preserving the exact framing, all object positions and 3:2 aspect ratio. White means ONLY soft loose fine pigment powder: the large turquoise mound in the lower middle, pale jade fine powder mound at lower right, small spilled powder patches near lower left-middle, fine turquoise powder inside the brass bowl. Black means everything else: all rigid mineral rocks and pebble chunks (including blue/green ones), table, empty dark background, brass bowl walls/rim, grinding pestle. Be conservative at all boundaries and leave a narrow black margin around rigid objects. Pure opaque black background with pure white flat filled powder shapes, no gray photo, no text, no outlines, no shadows. This is a technical segmentation of this exact artwork, not a new scene.

Correct this technical segmentation mask. The output must be 1536x1024. Fill all the black holes and dark ink-shaped channels INSIDE the white region with solid white; liquid and ink are BOTH interactive. Make the left side of the white silhouette a straight vertical edge at x=715 and right side a straight vertical edge at x=1400. The top edge is a straight horizontal line at y=170, the bottom edge is gently curved from y=725 at the sides to y=780 in the middle. White interior must be fully solid with absolutely no holes or texture, black everywhere outside. Preserve black background. Output only the corrected binary white liquid-interior silhouette on black, no labels.
